blends.name: PC Game to AV Software (Repair Card Scanners)
blends.desc:
Repair Faulty Card Scanners with your AV Software

1 AV Software - Floppy + Faulty Epic Card Scanner = Epic Card Scanner
2 AV Software - Floppys + Faulty Legendary Card Scanner = Legendary Card Scanner 

Once Bubba’s new AV Software has started to infiltrate Baron’s virus, look forward to Bubba’s AV Tickets appearing in Reward Pools next week! 

Receive 1 AV Ticket if Bubba intercepts your Blends! Bubba even managed to reverse the weighting ratio of Baron’s Error Tickets! 

Each AV Ticket will hold a higher weight in Blend Tickets

blends.name: Genesis PC to Golden Genesis
blends.desc:
Redeem your Golden PC Ticket for a Golden Genesis PC! (Obtained from Character Card Packs)

This Ticket upgrades your PC to a Golden Genesis PC (Legendary) that earns 3x Blend Tickets during NFT Generation Phase. Golden Genesis PC will also hold a higher weight when upgrading to Season 2!
